title: Repeat-failure lessons library
summary: Sixty-two short never-again rules, each with its reason and the incident class it prevents, kept in one lessons file with a single pointer line in CLAUDE.md.
why: Each rule was paid for by a real failure that happened more than once; one line of reading is cheaper than another round of the same incident. CLAUDE.md gets one pointer, so its size budget is untouched.

items.title: ASCII only in scripts, configs and docs
items.does: Keep scripts, configs and docs ASCII only.
items.why: A typographic dash in a script without a byte-order mark was decoded in the legacy code page and ended a string early.

detect.regex: Keep scripts, configs and docs ASCII only

items.notes: Canonical: rule-encoding-ascii-lf; this lesson records the incident class and adds no second contribution.

items.title: Write bytes explicitly when bytes matter
items.does: Write files as bytes, or with an explicit newline setting, whenever sizes or hashes matter.
items.why: Text-mode writes on Windows turn LF into CRLF, so byte counts and hashes stop matching what was meant.

detect.regex: Write files as bytes, or with an explicit newline setting, whenever sizes or hashes matter
Write files as bytes, or with an explicit newline setting, whenever sizes or hashes matter

verify.match: Write files as bytes, or with an explicit newline setting, whenever sizes or hashes matter
